title: Oklahoma 23, Alabama 21: The 2025 Upset in Tuscaloosa
question: When did Oklahoma beat Alabama 23-21 in Tuscaloosa in 2025?
answer: On November 15, 2025, No. 11 Oklahoma beat No. 4 Alabama 23-21 at Bryant-Denny Stadium. The Sooners forced three turnovers, turned them into 17 points and ended Alabama's 17-game home winning streak.
summary: On Nov. 15, 2025, No. 11 Oklahoma upset No. 4 Alabama 23-21 in Tuscaloosa, ending the Crimson Tide's 17-game home winning streak behind a defense-led effort.
body: One year ago today, Oklahoma walked into Bryant-Denny Stadium as the No. 11 team in the College Football Playoff rankings and walked out with one of the biggest wins of its first SEC season. The Sooners beat No. 4 Alabama 23-21 on November 15, 2025.

The game was won by defense and special teams. Oklahoma forced three turnovers, one interception and two fumble recoveries, and turned them into 17 points. Eli Bowen returned an interception 87 yards for a touchdown, and a 46-yard punt return set up Oklahoma's first score. John Mateer added a rushing touchdown.

Alabama still piled up yards. Quarterback Ty Simpson threw for 326 yards and a touchdown to Josh Cuevas, and Daniel Hill scored twice. Oklahoma finished with just 212 yards of offense, with Mateer accounting for 161 of them.

The finish belonged to the Sooners' defense. Oklahoma held Alabama to 57 yards over its final four drives, and Kip Lewis, who had two sacks, helped close it out. Simpson's fourth-down pass to Ryan Williams fell incomplete on the last play.

The win ended Alabama's 17-game home winning streak, handed Kalen DeBoer his first loss at Bryant-Denny, and snapped an eight-game Alabama winning streak. It came a week after a 23-6 loss to Texas and moved Oklahoma to 8-2.
